users_same_organization_select.name: users_same_organization_select
users_same_organization_select.using: "better_auth"."users"."id" in (select user_id from public.members where organization_id = (select app.org_id()))

artifact_versions_tenant_insert.name: artifact_versions_tenant_insert
artifact_versions_tenant_insert.withCheck: "artifact_versions"."organization_id" = (select app.org_id()) and exists (select 1 from public.artifacts a where a.id = "artifact_versions"."artifact_id" and (a.created_by = (select app.user_id()) or (select app.has_permission('artifact:update'))))

team_members_tenant_select.name: team_members_tenant_select
team_members_tenant_select.using: "team_members"."team_id" in (select id from public.teams where organization_id = (select app.org_id()))
